apps.hero.title: Every app comes with clear guidance and data boundaries you control.
apps.hero.desc: Find product overviews, getting-started guides, privacy policies, terms, and technical support here. Read the section for the platform you actually use.
apps.memoria.desc: Track birthdays, anniversaries, and countdowns. The iOS version supports optional private iCloud sync; the Huawei AppGallery edition of Memoria is fully on-device.
apps.timetrails.desc: Privacy-first GPS track logging: automatically records trips, workouts, and journeys, drawing your footprints on the map and lighting up the cities you've visited. Tracks stay on-device by default, with optional private iCloud backup.
apps.traceapp.desc: Records path, distance, speed, and pace. No account, no built-in ads or third-party analytics.
support.hero.title: Reach TreeHouse the way that suits you best.
support.hero.desc: All official support channels for TreeHouse apps in one place: feedback, app-store reviews, and official community groups. Local-first, no ads, no third-party tracking.
support.g1.title: Feedback
support.g1.note: Hit a problem or have an idea? Reach us any way below — we read every message.
support.g1.feedback.name: In-app Feedback
support.g1.feedback.desc: Submit inside each app; your version, device, and system info are attached automatically so we can look into it faster.
support.g1.email.name: Send email
support.g1.email.desc: For formal requests and privacy or account matters, email gets a fuller reply.
support.g2.title: Rate the apps (per app)
support.g2.note: If you like them, leave a review in the store you use — we see it and reply. Tap the one that matches your app.
support.g3.title: WeChat · QQ · Telegram groups
support.g3.note: Join our official groups for updates and peer help: WeChat / QQ in China, Telegram elsewhere.
support.g3.wechat.name: WeChat group
support.g3.wechat.desc: Everyday chat and help. A new QR code is posted when a group fills up.
support.g3.qq.name: QQ group
support.g3.qq.desc: For users in China; high member cap.
support.g3.tg.name: Telegram group
support.g3.tg.desc: Chat and Q&A for international users.
